question: The period between the prorogation of a House and its reassembly in a new session is called ______
solution:
The correct answer** **is__** recess.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• **The time between prorogation and reassembly is called Recess.**

 
 
• **In India, the Parliament conducts three sessions each year:**
 
• **Budget session: January or February to May.**
 
• **Monsoon session: July to August or September.**
 
• **Winter session: November to December. **
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cf0b312b7f21633d796e42a8a730c2921ca9d87603221c5efcabbdc14cb4b749.png] 

 
• A session of the Indian Parliament is the period during which a House meets almost every day uninterruptedly to manage the business.
 
• The process of calling all members of the Parliament to meet is called Summoning of Parliament. The joint sitting of the Parliament is called by the President of India (Article 108) and is presided over by the Speaker of the Lok Sabha or, in their absence, by the Deputy Speaker of the Lok Sabha, or in their absence, the Deputy Chairman of the Rajya Sabha.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• The Parliament of India is the supreme legislative body of the Republic of India.
 
• It is a bicameral legislature composed of the President of India and the two houses: the Rajya Sabha and the Lok Sabha. 
 
• Houses: Rajya Sabha (Upper house); Lok Sabha (Lower house)
 
• Founded: 26 January 1950
 
• Seats: 788: 245 Members of Rajya Sabha; 543 Members of Lok Sabha
 
• Speaker of the Lok Sabha: Om Birla
 
• Lok Sabha next election: May 2024
 
• Lok Sabha voting system: First-past-the-post
 
• Rajya Sabha voting system: Single transferable vote
